Definition: or ἐλάττων comparative of the same as G1646; smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality):--less, under, worse, younger.
BiblicalUsage: elássōn is a plain word for less, smaller. In John 2:10, the text says "then that which is worse." In Romans 9:12, the text says "The elder shall serve the younger."
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: elássōn tells me that humility is not thinking less of ourselves; it is thinking of ourselves less, and of God more. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
